All seven subtasks of the item-tool task are done and marked complete in its log (completion 1.0), committed on `worktree/qf-5` (9f98c3c70, 768ba7b99). It still needs your merge to michael/dev and a Servex restart before the new tool is live.

**What the tool does now**
- **Page:** a page answers as the real `Page` in node. The tool refuses a `_` key, an unregistered `part-*` type, or a line that `Page.replay` would throw on, before anything is written. Parts, the tool and the tests share one part-type list in `parts/kinds.js`.
- **Queries:** a query key answers without writing. A query key given a string, number or `false` is refused.
- **Replay:** a line that would break replay is refused before it is written. A `tasks.add` array writes nothing if any member is bad.
- **Tests:** these pass: item_tool 92, page_tools 27, Page 15, Task 58, Session 7.

- It is running, 9 of 132 tasks done (completion 0.068), 50 tasks open, running time about 24.3 hours.
- Task states: running 10, complete 9, stopped 73, idle 28, waiting 12.
- It has 7 child sessions, including process-system, figma-cards, readme-roles (complete), worktree-closure (complete), prompt-records, test-system and task-resolution.
- Cost reads 0 because I ran it in a plain script, not inside Servex.

The three tests are committed on `worktree/page-tests` at `08c205420`, and I've sent the ready line to `mastermind-page`. Store and streaming pass. List passes except one check that needs the `qf-5` fix. I ran each test with plain `node`. I ran them through `TestRunner.mjs` as well, by passing it the test folders; given a single file path it ran nothing.

- **`Store.test.mjs`:** 10 checks pass. A `set()` appends one line, a replay rebuilds the same state, and a child with its own file writes that file and adds only a note to the root.
- **`List.test.mjs`:** add, remove, move and order each survive a save and a replay. The `add([a, b])` check fails with `[null]` on this branch. `worktree/qf-5` fixes `List.js`, so it should pass once that merges. I left it failing, as the brief says.
- **`Stream.test.mjs`:** 6 checks pass, and the whole trip takes about 5 ms. It sits beside `Tail.js`. The browser side is `Socket.prototype.jsonl` at `ext/JSONL/live.js:35`, which calls the store's `read()` and so applies each line to the page.
  - **Hand-made stand-ins:** the test fakes `location` and `Element` and has its own loader hook for `/framework/` imports. `qf-5`'s View guard and `Servex/agents/site-hooks.mjs` aren't on this branch.
  - **Watcher:** it calls `Tail.changed()` directly in place of the dev server's file watcher.

The streaming test found a real bug in `Item.js`, which I fixed:
- **Cause:** the constructor assigned fields before `this.data` existed, so `new Page({title})` created an own `title` property that shadowed the accessor.
- **Effect:** a live rename in `page.jsonl` updated `data` but `page.title` kept the old value.
- **Fix and check:** `Item.js` now creates `data` first, and `Item.test.mjs` has a regression check. The same set of tests passes and fails as before the fix.

Two failures were already there and aren't mine: `Append.test.mjs` and `AITask/tree.test.mjs`.

The branch `worktree/near-tests` is ready at `5bbd77794`, with all three parts built and proved. I logged `ready:` on the task and messaged `mastermind-page`.

- **TestRunner:** `--near <file>` lists the tests in that file's folder plus the tests that import it directly, using the same import resolver `--covers` uses. A single test file path now runs that file, as you asked, and `TestRunner.test.mjs` checks it. The 60 s timeout was already there; a timed-out run is logged and counts as no result.
- **merge.mjs:** a new `Server/MergeTests.mjs` runs every test that covers the diff on the branch. A test that fails there is run on the merge base, and the merge is refused only when it passes on the base. A branch timeout never refuses. The base results are cached by sha in `results.jsonl`, and `--skip-tests` is added. Four new scratch-repo proofs in `Server/merge.test.mjs` pass: refused when pass-to-fail, lands when already failing on the base, lands on a branch timeout, and `--skip-tests` runs nothing.
- **WorktreeWatch:** a `.js` or `.mjs` save runs its near tests after the 2 s debounce, and a `files.jsonl` write runs nothing. There is one shared queue of at most 3 runs, and a new change replaces that worktree's waiting run. The holder gets one message on pass to fail. Fail to pass gets only a log line. `Servex/WorktreeWatch.test.mjs` covers this with a fake `send`.

**Choices you didn't specify:**
- **Base run:** the base is run only for tests that fail on the branch, since a test that passes on the branch can't be refused.
- **Base checkout:** the checkout goes under `MAIN/.merge-base`, so node finds the main `node_modules`. It is excluded locally and removed after each run.
- **New failing tests:** a new test that fails on the branch, with no base result, only warns.
- **Dry run:** a dry run skips the tests.
- **First report:** a test with no earlier result that fails on its first run is reported once.
- **Cache lines:** `TestResults.js` ignores the cache lines, which carry a `sha`, so they don't overwrite a file's latest row.
- **Env vars:** `TESTRUNNER_RESULTS` and `TESTRUNNER_TIMEOUT` exist for proofs.

All six review items are fixed and committed; the branch is ready at fe4c446f9. I logged a new `ready:` line and messaged `mastermind-page`.

- **Readmes:** `Server/readme.md` now names the `/api/folder-names` route, and `ai/AITask/readme.md` says `has()` uses the listing with a HEAD fallback and that `session()` picks the record name.
- **One listing:** `ai/AITask/listing.js` `names(dir)` now asks `/api/folder-names` and replaces `directory.json`. `AITask.route()` uses it for both dated and sessions-store folders. Only `AITask.js` imported `listing.js`, so nothing else needed changing.
- **Off the dev server:** the listing asks nothing there. It uses a new `Store.local()` (the same check `Store.open` used), so production makes no request to `/api/folder-names`.
- **Decode:** `FolderNames.js` no longer decodes the query twice; a literal `%` now returns `{"names":[]}` instead of a 500.
- **Decision record:** I logged a correction that the cache is 3 s, not 10 s.
- **Unknown-verb warnings:** the warning comes from `skip()` in `ext/JSONL/JSONL.js`. The session's own `session.jsonl` (e00f55c9) had 10 distinct unknown keys: `by` and `ts` (289 each), `tasks` (282), `sessions` (4), `task` (2), and one each of `session`, `start`, `stop`, `as` and `moved_from`. The `deputy` logs added `commit`, `task` and `wait`. These are log-writer stamps plus verbs `core/Task` replays from the same file. I added a `quiet` list so they are recorded but no longer warn; the per-file counts are in the log.

A dev server started before this branch has no `/api/folder-names`. Pages fall back to the old probes, and their 404s, until it restarts.

The Tabs page now loads with no error, and its demo tabs no longer link to `undefined…` urls. The fix is on `worktree/ext-tabs` at `613bad36b`. I haven't merged it.

- **Cause:** both demos in `ext/tabs/page.js` pass `title: ""`, so `Page.naming()` (`Page.class.js:251`) gave the demo root no url. `tabs.js:79` then built `undefined + name`, and `settings.js:115` threw "Invalid base URL".
- **Fix:** I gave each demo root an explicit `url` in `ext/tabs/page.js`. In `tabs.js` I added one call to `this.app?.mark?.()`. That makes a demo box re-mark itself after the tab bar redraws, so the demo tab links stay inert. Real pages are unaffected, because `App` has no `mark`.
- **Smoke before and after:** the before run was 19 FAIL on `/framework/ext/tabs/` alone: the page, every tab under it, and the `undefinedwhy` / `undefinednotes` links. After the fix, `/framework/ext/tabs/`, `/framework/ext/Doc/` and `/framework/core/Page/` give 3 FAIL, none in ext/tabs. The three are `/framework/ext/Panel/`, which was already failing before, and two session `?tab=coverage` pages linked from `ext/Doc/`, which I didn't touch.
- **Demo tab links:** in the browser they have no `href` and carry `data-demo-url` of `/tabs-demo/`, `/tabs-demo/why/`, `/tabs-demo-block/` and `/tabs-demo-block/notes/`. They are inert on purpose, because `smoke.mjs` crawls every `href` and fails on pages that don't exist. That is looser than the brief's "real urls", since the urls name pages that don't exist.
- **Shot:** the 1920 shot is saved at `C:/Users/mike/AppData/Local/Temp/tabs-after.png`. I never opened it, so I haven't seen both demos with their tab bars.
- **Checks and logging:** `node --check` passed on both files. I logged the before/after numbers, the decision and the ready line on the task, and told `mastermind-page`.
- **Alternative I didn't take:** giving a titleless root a default url in `Page.naming()` or `DemoApp`. That touches core for every page.
